subject: Draft MAP & sequencing: MSA / DPA / Order Form gating
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: HelioHealth — draft milestones and gating

Team — attaching an initial mutual action plan (MAP_Helio_v1.xlsx) that aligns evaluation milestones with procurement/legal gating. High level asks: 

- Confirm DPA carve-outs we discussed last week are required by legal before order form signature (PI processing, subprocessor list, deletion windows).
- Identify the minimum evidence set procurement needs to start purchase approval in parallel (SOC2 report + encryption KMS attestation + data residency confirmation).
- Propose a conservative close timeline vs an accelerated path (2-stage vs 3-stage) based on how fast legal can validate DPA.

Proposed milestones in the sheet: discovery demo (complete), evaluation POC (2 weeks), security evidence review (legal/procurement parallel), MSA finalization, DPA sign (if needed pre-order), order form execution, pilot activation.

Can you each take a pass by EOD and add blocking items or tighten durations? I'm intentionally leaving one lane for procurement contingencies so we can present both "standard" and "expedite" flows to Helio.

Thanks — k

Attachment: MAP_Helio_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-16T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: HelioHealth — draft milestones and gating

Karthik — thanks for the draft. Quick notes after a first pass (see inline on MAP_Helio_v1.xlsx):

- DPA gating: Legal needs the redline pass on our standard DPA. If Helio requires additional clauses (notably reverse engineering and processor-to-processor flow-downs), that will push the DPA timeline by ~5 business days. Recommend we lock a DPA-sign-first option only for the expedite path; standard path allows order form to be signed with DPA to follow within a defined window.
- Evidence minimum: procurement can begin approvals with the most recent SOC2 Type II report + a short KMS architecture note (1 page). Anything beyond that is "nice to have" but will not block CFO approval in most mid-market deals.
- Data residency: Confirmed we can commit to US-only tenancy for this initial pilot; include explicit region clause in the order form.

Action items for me: I'll produce a 1-page DPA summary (DPA_redlines_irene_notes.pdf) that highlights risky clauses and a recommended compromise for procurement. Laura — can you update the MAP with acceptance criteria and a sign-off owner per milestone?

Irene

Attachment: DPA_redlines_irene_notes.pdf (brief PDF, 3 pages)
From: Emma Ruiz <emma@heliohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-17T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: HelioHealth — draft milestones and gating

Thanks Karthik / Irene — quick context from procurement side: Helio's board has asked us to aim for a July activation for the pilot (two-week POC then pilot). To hit that, we need to compress the security review timeline and run procurement approval in parallel with legal.

What would help on your end: 
- If Redwood can accept a short-term order form signature contingent on DPA closure within 10 business days, procurement can approve the spend earlier.
- Provide SOC2 + KMS note ASAP (we've received the SOC2 link; appreciate the KMS one-pager).

We prefer not to sign an order form if there are open material DPA redlines, but given the pilot size we can do the contingent/order-then-DPA route if Redwood's legal teams are comfortable with the contingency language.

Availability: I can do a quick call at 11:30 PT today if you want to triage redlines with our GC.

— Emma
Procurement Manager, HelioHealth
procurement@heliohealth.com

Attachment: (none)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Ruiz <emma@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2025-07-17T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: HelioHealth — draft milestones and gating

Looping everyone with an updated sequencing plan and clear next steps (see attached OrderForm_Draft.docx). Key points: 

1) Two-path approach (documented in MAP):
   - Standard: MSA sign -> Order form sign -> DPA sign within 15 business days (recommended for larger commitments).
   - Expedite: Order form sign (contingent) -> DPA sign within 10 business days -> Pilot activation. Contingent language: escrowed signature and automatic pilot suspension if DPA not executed within window.

2) Milestone owners and acceptance criteria: I've added a new "Owner" column (Legal: Irene; Procurement contact: Emma; Sales: Karthik) and specific acceptance triggers (SOC2 yes/no, KMS notes received, signed MSA or contingency clause).

3) Risk and fallback: If DPA redlines require >10 days, we will: a) limit pilot to obfuscated data and reduced retention, or b) proceed with isolated dedicated tenancy (extra ops lead). Both options are noted with estimated cost/time impacts.

Next steps: 
- Irene: finalize the DPA summary and proposed compromise text (target EOD tomorrow).
- Karthik: confirm internal approvals to accept contingency language and pricing implications.
- Emma: confirm whether Helio can accept the contingency approach and if they want our GC on the 11:30 PT call.

I've uploaded the updated MAP and order form to the deal folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP and created a HubSpot note: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HHL-2347. I'll also prepare a short DocuSign envelope once DPA compromise language is approved.

Laura Bennett
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: OrderForm_Draft.docx (MS Word)
